blurb: City Grazing rents out goats to graze on public and private properties for weed removal, fire hazard reduction, and soil improvement. They also offer educational programs about grazing benefits and sustainability. Their herd consists of adopted goats living in San Francisco's Bayview district.
extraNote: Pricing varies based on property size, location, fencing needs, and vegetation · Discounts if client provides fencing and/or daily staff check · Herd lives at headquarters in San Francisco’s Bayview district
